fields.name: Host
fields.description: Target host where Fluent Bit or Fluentd are listening for Forward messages.

fields.name: Port
fields.description: TCP Port of the target service.

fields.name: Time_as_Integer
fields.description: Set timestamps in integer format, it enables compatibility mode for Fluentd v0.12 series.

fields.name: Upstream
fields.description: If Forward will connect to an Upstream instead of a basic host, this property defines the absolute path for the Upstream configuration file, for more details about this, see Upstream Servers .

fields.name: Unix_Path
fields.description: Specify the path to a Unix socket to send a Forward message. If set, Upstream is ignored.

fields.name: Tag
fields.description: Overwrite the tag as Fluent Bit transmits. This allows the receiving pipeline start fresh, or to attribute a source.

fields.name: Require_ack_response
fields.description: Send chunk option and wait for an ack response from the server. Enables at-least-once and receiving server can control rate of traffic. Requires Fluentd v0.14.0+ or later

fields.name: Compress
fields.description: Set to gzip to enable gzip compression. Incompatible with Time_as_Integer=True and tags set dynamically using the Rewrite Tag filter. Requires Fluentd server v0.14.7 or later.

fields.name: Workers
fields.description: The number of workers to perform flush operations for this output.

fields.name: match
fields.description: Tag match pattern used to route records to this plugin. Supports '*' wildcard matching.

fields.name: match_regex
fields.description: Regular expression tag match used to route records to this plugin. Takes precedence over match when both are set.
